findings: learner.overview.text and learner.components[0].text present the bronze analysis as established: qualify it as one reported interpretation, since the component split and 八’s division role are source analyses, and the phonetic role remains uncertain (X-8d7a753fd199ce85f51e, X-fb90cf715b7d71212e4d, X-e4e939cc36ce7f6be66a). The cards already say “reported” and identify the sound role as uncertain, but the overview’s plain assertion that 八 marks division and 牛 depicts the ox is not clearly framed as that account’s interpretation.

summary.text and formation.text call 八 a marker of division and 牛 the depicted ox without making clear that these are reported analyses of the bronze form, not established historical facts. Recast both as proposed/source-reported interpretations while retaining the supported construction and the uncertainty about chronology and sound role (X-8d7a753fd199ce85f51e, X-fb90cf715b7d71212e4d, X-e4e939cc36ce7f6be66a).
